### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/3e14bd781a230b3fc937fd6e46a62b8b87232bab/experiments/material-facts-v7/assess.mjs#L201 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Refuse to overwrite frozen assessment reports** When this CLI is pointed at an existing formal `results/*/report.json`, `writeFile` silently truncates and replaces the frozen first-run report. This is especially hazardous now that the live scorer differs from the archived scorer: recomputing the Qwen report with the current tree produces the correction-v4 bytes rather than the original report, destroying the historical evidence and making frozen verification fail. Use exclusive creation or explicitly prohibit output paths inside frozen result directories. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L9-L9](https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/3e14bd781a230b3fc937fd6e46a62b8b87232bab/AGENTS.md#L9-L9)
ℹ️ About Codex in GitHub
[Your team has set up Codex to review pull requests in this repo](https://chatgpt.com/codex/cloud/settings/general). Reviews are triggered when you - Open a pull request for review - Mark a draft as ready - Comment "@codex review". If Codex has suggestions, it will comment; otherwise it will react with 👍. Codex can also answer questions or update the PR. Try commenting "@codex address that feedback".
